blocks.text: Group 2 ki sab metals oxygen mein jal kar metal oxides (MO) banati hain.

Beryllium (Be) oxygen se sirf high temperature (600 °C se upar) par react kar ke BeO banata hai. Is par aam taur par oxide ki ek patli magar mazboot layer (teh) chadhi hoti hai jo ise bachati hai, is liye yeh group ke baqi members se kam reactive hai.
Magnesium (Mg) hawa ya oxygen mein tez roshni ke saath jal kar magnesium oxide (MgO) banata hai. Calcium (Ca) ka oxygen se reaction is se bhi tez hai aur eent jaisa laal (brick red) shola deta hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar shole (flames) saath saath, Mg, Ca, Sr aur Ba likhe hue: magnesium ka shola safaid, calcium ka kinaron par laal aur beech mein peela, strontium ka laal aur barium ka hara.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.2: Group 2 elements ke flames (shole) (kitab ki Figure 17.2 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Magnesium tez safaid roshni se jalta hai. Calcium ka shola brick red (eent jaisa laal) hai, strontium ka gehra laal (crimson) aur barium ka halka hara (apple green). Inhi rangon ki wajah se yeh metals fireworks mein istemal hoti hain.

Group 2 elements ke oxides aam taur par safaid solids hain aur basic (tezaab ke ulat) nature rakhte hain; group mein neeche in ka basic character barhta hai. Paani mein yeh basic is liye hain ke oxide ion (O²⁻) paani se react kar ke OH⁻ (hydroxide) ion banata hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Basic oxide woh oxide hai jo paani se react kar ke OH⁻ ions banaye (ya acid se react kar ke salt aur paani de). Group 2 ke oxides basic oxides hain; jitne zyada OH⁻ ions, utna zyada basic solution.

blocks.prompt: Calcium ke oxygen mein jalne ki equation likhein.

items: 2M + O₂ → 2MO; Be sirf 600 °C se upar react karta hai (oxide ki protective layer).
Mg tez safaid roshni se, Ca brick red shole ke saath jalta hai.
Group 2 oxides safaid aur basic; O²⁻ + H₂O → 2OH⁻; basic character neeche barhta hai.
